title: Ho3Fe5O12 nanoparticles immobilized on FPS for production of a biopolymer from CO2 and limonene epoxide
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37431-37437
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05285D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Fatemeh Shafiezadeh, Ali Javid, Rahele Zhiani, Sadegh Allameh
Ho3Fe5O12@FPS was synthesized for the first time using an advanced and environmentally friendly method. Subsequently, Ho3Fe5O12@FPS was used as a long-lasting and reusable adsorbent for the reaction of carbon dioxide with limonene epoxide.
